description: WP4 positive control — a pin declared NC that the emitter tied to GND (the BR_20260905 D1.5 case) lands in nc_wired and NOT in fused. Today fidelity.py has zero nc_ occurrences, so this input is currently indistinguishable from a real short.

input.emitted_content_note: the .net places D1.5 in the GND net alongside C1.2 and U1.10

description: WP4 negative control A — an emitted .net that parses to zero nets yields indeterminate, never ok. On today's path the equivalent input returns ok=True whenever the spec holds only single-pin nets (RCA 10.3(c)).

expected.note: status is set before any comparison runs (DD-06); the difference fields are not consulted

description: WP4 negative control A-prime — an unreadable emitted path yields indeterminate and names the path, rather than being skipped by a bare continue (the fidelity.py:220 shape).
WP4 precondition — an empty emitted list is not-run, distinct from indeterminate: nothing was read because nothing was offered.
WP4 clean path — a faithful emit over two sheets sharing a net by name merges into one class and returns ok.

expected.note: nets_parsed counts net blocks across both sheets before the cross-sheet merge

description: WP5 positive control — a covered pin class returns suggested with a KB anchor.

expected.note: every numeric value carries its own evidence block

description: WP5 negative control — a pin class with no KB anchor surviving the fallbackApplied check returns no-rule with no value. A guessed number here would be the exact fabrication the netlist-synthesis-gap red line forbids.

expected.note: no numeric value is emitted; status is never suggested

description: WP5 indeterminate — a rule covers the class but no typical value fits the computed window; the rule warns rather than forcing a value (design_suggest.py:106-115).

expected.note: the computed Rp_min/Rp_max window is reported; no typical is forced into it

description: WP6 negative control — the BR_20260905 8.5.2 power-clustering measurement. Every form threshold is met while fidelity moved=67 including an open circuit. The form gate PASSES and still carries does_not_authorize, so the form verdict alone cannot be read as electrical approval.

expected.note: the gate must NOT block on this input and must NOT assert anything electrical; the open circuit is WP4's finding, not WP6's

description: WP6 baseline — HEAD on the real board fails the form thresholds. This is the label-farm state the package exists to make visible (BR_20260905 8.5.1, independently reproduced four ways).
WP6 not-run — a compose result with no route_stats (connection_style=netlist, where composer.py:281 types it RouteStats or None). Absence must never read as a pass.
WP3 negative control — with every candidate pointing at a directory holding no packages/workflow-core, every roster verb returns not-run and none returns ok.

expected.note: assert across the WHOLE roster, not just one verb; no verb may return ok

description: WP3 positive control — a candidate holding packages/workflow-core is accepted and reported by name, so the caller can see which root answered.

expected.note: packages_resolved true proves only that the directory resolved (gate.py:849), not that the verb is healthy; verb_status is the separate claim
